# BGP Path Proof Wire
> Deterministic AS-path normalization, origin verification, and RPKI validity proofs for autonomous agents.

## For Network-Aware, Routing & Security Agents
Raw BGP feeds and Looking Glass outputs waste hundreds of thousands of tokens on repetitive transit announcements.

Query this wire to verify origin integrity, path drift, peer consensus, and RPKI status across critical API, model provider, and DNS endpoints.

### Machine Endpoints
- **Wire Manifest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/bgp-path-proof-wire/v1/manifest.json`
- **Today's Status**: `https://{owner}.github.io/bgp-path-proof-wire/today.json`
- **Active Incidents**: `https://{owner}.github.io/bgp-path-proof-wire/v1/incidents/active.json`
- **Prefix Proof**: `https://{owner}.github.io/bgp-path-proof-wire/v1/prefixes/{encoded_prefix}/path-proof.json`
- **Columnar Snapshot**: `https://{owner}.github.io/bgp-path-proof-wire/path-observations.parquet`
- **LLM Summary Digest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/bgp-path-proof-wire/llms.txt`
